text: Artificial intelligence is changing the way we think about creativity. Today, AI tools can create art, compose music, and even write stories or articles. These programs learn from huge amounts of data and then produce new work in a similar style. However, there is an important difference between human and machine creativity. Humans create from emotions, personal experiences, and imagination. AI, on the other hand, simply recognises patterns and combines them. While AI-generated art and music can be impressive, many people believe that true creativity requires a human heart and mind. Perhaps the best results come when humans and machines work together.
